نغدودن (form XII)
# نَغْدَوْدِنُ (naḡdawdinu) /naɣ.daw.di.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِغْدَوْدَنَ (iḡdawdana)
# نَغْدَوْدِنَ (naḡdawdina) /naɣ.daw.di.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِغْدَوْدَنَ (iḡdawdana)
# نَغْدَوْدِنْ (naḡdawdin) /naɣ.daw.din/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِغْدَوْدَنَ (iḡdawdana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
